question: An object is placed in front of a concave mirror at a point beyond its centre of curvature C. The image is formed at a point ______ and is ______.
solution:
The correct answer is__** between F and C, diminished**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• An object is placed in front of a concave mirror at a point beyond its centre of curvature C, the image is formed at a point that is between the** centre of curvature and the focus (C and F respectively)**,__ and is real, inverted and smaller than the object.
 
• When an object is placed at a point beyond the centre of curvature of a concave mirror, the reflected rays converge at a point before the mirror,** creating a real image that is inverted and smaller than the object**. The image is also located between the** centre of curvature and the focus** of the mirror.
 
• It's also worth noting that in this case, the image is also always virtual, since the image is formed "**behind**" the mirror, meaning that it cannot be projected on a screen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• When an object is placed at a point beyond the centre of curvature (C) of a concave mirror, the reflected rays converge at a point before the mirror, creating **a real image that is inverted (upside-down) and smaller than the object**. The image is also located between the centre of **curvature and the focus (F) of the mirror.**
 
• Additionally, it is also worth noting that the **distance of the object (u), the distance of the image (v), and the focal length (f) **of the mirror are related by the mirror equation:
 
• **1/f = 1/v - 1/u**
 
• Where, a negative value of v represents that the image is real, inverted and on the same side of the mirror as the object, and** a positive value of v** represents that** the image is virtual, erect and on the opposite side of the mirror.**
 
• Also, The image is always** diminished in size as the object is beyond the centre of curvature of the mirror**, The image is also always **virtual**, since the image is formed "**behind**" the mirror, meaning that it cannot be projected on a screen.
